claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied Q with success at least 0.39 under the heuristics of proof.md section 10, and all classical work is bounded by 2^120.458180576 dense-Fp12 units (ledger: proof.md section 8). Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Eight parts, each inside the hosted limits (proof.md Claim): core (initial: region and collection from the 16 shipped pool-chunk sums, the descent recurrence with [7u] and the lazy simulation [7l], the success bound, the ledger sum against the claim, every declared bound vs its unrounded value), ledger (core's ledger plus [2] pool-list integrity on uniform draws and the 64 anchors, [6], [6b], [7c], [9], [10], [13], [14]), descent (core's descent plus [7r], [7s] incl. the common-shock tolerance, the direct [7u] sums), lattices ([11], [12], [13]), retention ([11b]), losses ([11c]), conc (the realized missing-log table: [7e], [7t], [7p], [7v], and [7j] the joint-occurrence premise of S_0), pool ([2p]: regenerates one of the 16 chunks of pool12.b85 from (seed, index) and checks its sums against pool_sums.json; chunk = the input chunk, else seed mod 16). seed changes every sampled quantity; samples is the number of uniform draws checked by [2].
